name: M0 behavior-equivalent migration acceptance matrix

gates.requirement: main history and required tags/selected branches are preserved or mapping is documented
web/native package manifests and lockfiles are byte-identical unless explicitly documented
canonical build completes from clean checkout
generated outputs are identical or every path delta is attributable only to unavoidable repository-origin metadata
all source/unit/schema/world/integration tests pass
secret/private-data scan and production dependency audits pass; no permission broadening
internal home/discover/garage/plan/me routes remain functional and deep links still resolve
guest-first use remains possible; registration is not accidentally required
current kona.* and legacy speedmax.* compatible fixtures read identically; no key is deleted
GameState backup/restore schema remains compatible
magic-link/auth callback flow remains equivalent
service worker/install behavior and manifest scope remain equivalent for M0
museum/world loads and primary movement/selection/return flows behave equivalently
Studio startup, product loading, configuration and failure fallback remain equivalent
no unintended visual delta across phone320/360/390/430, short landscape and desktop
all primary visible controls remain reachable and persist intended outcomes
bundle budgets do not regress; no new first-load 3D or renderer cost
required public assets exist and hashes/paths remain valid
one canonical publisher deploys exact certified target SHA; no competing deploy source
old canyonmuseum production remains available until Kona.m M0 is proven; rollback instructions tested conceptually
record status honestly; if native/mobile release is claimed, physical install/rotate/background/return proof required
record status honestly; if iOS/PWA release is claimed, Safari/Add-to-Home-Screen/safe-area/background proof required

pass_rule: All blocking gates PASS on one exact target SHA. Non-blocking physical gates may remain OPEN only if no claim of full physical-device certification is made.
prohibited_shortcuts: carry green checks from another SHA
